trips = tables['trips']

recent = trips[(trips['fished_date_season'] == 2) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 214)]

    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'nunique'
}).reset_index()
recent_agg['yt_per_angler'] = recent_agg['yt'] / recent_agg['anglers']
recent_agg.columns = ['doy', 'yt_total', 'anglers', 'boats', 'yt_per_angler']

print("Season 2, Last 30 days (d214-d244):")

# Check Season 1 October (DOY 287-301)
s1_oct = trips[(trips['fished_date_season'] == 1) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 287) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 301)]

}).reset_index()

s1_oct_agg.columns = ['doy', 'yt_total', 'anglers', 'boats', 'yt_per_angler']

import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# Best boats in Season 1 October by class
s1_oct = trips[(trips['fished_date_season'] == 1) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 287) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 301)]
s1_oct_by_boat = s1_oct.groupby(['boat', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'fished_date_doy': 'count'
}).reset_index()
s1_oct_by_boat['yt_per_angler'] = s1_oct_by_boat['yt'] / s1_oct_by_boat['anglers']
s1_oct_by_boat.columns = ['boat', 'cls', 'yt_total', 'anglers', 'trips', 'yt_per_angler']

# Filter for day_1_5 specifically
day15_oct = s1_oct_by_boat[s1_oct_by_boat['cls'] == 'day_1_5'].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
print("Season 1 October - Best DAY_1_5 boats:")
print(day15_oct.head(10).to_string())

print("\n" + "="*60 + "\n")

# Check upcoming schedule for October options (what's scheduled for d287+)
schedule = tables['schedule']
oct_schedule = schedule[(schedule['fish_date_season'] == 2) & (schedule['fish_date_doy'] >= 287) & (schedule['fish_date_doy'] <= 310)]
oct_schedule_agg = oct_schedule.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls', 'boat']).size().reset_index(name='count')
day15_scheduled = oct_schedule_agg[oct_schedule_agg['cls'] == 'day_1_5'].sort_values(['fish_date_doy', 'boat'])

print("Upcoming October Schedule (DAY_1_5 only, d287-310):")
print(day15_scheduled.to_string())

print("\n" + "="*60 + "\n")

# What boats are running day_1_5 in October?
day15_boats_oct = day15_scheduled['boat'].unique()
print(f"Boats running DAY_1_5 in Oct: {', '.join(day15_boats_oct)}")

# For each boat, show its S1 October performance
print("\nS1 Oct Performance of Oct-Scheduled Boats (DAY_1_5):")
for boat in day15_boats_oct:
    boat_data = day15_oct[day15_oct['boat'] == boat]
    if len(boat_data) > 0:
        avg_share = boat_data['yt_per_angler'].values[0]
        trips_run = int(boat_data['trips'].values[0])
        print(f"  {boat}: {avg_share:.3f} yt/angler ({trips_run} trips)")
    else:
        print(f"  {boat}: No S1 Oct day_1_5 data")
